t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I have to be quick and respond in 1.5 seconds. The multipliers are the most important part for good points and certain gnomes and colors are better for results than the others.

vb_textbox.text: I found that during the different rounds, certain gnomes were better for me in the amount of mushrooms I got. Whichever color works best for you in the round, keep choosing them and that will help give you a lot more points when the 5x multiplier comes up. After each break, some of the gnomes that gave me better points before don't anymore, so try to remember the other colored gnomes that now are better for your points. Some of the gnomes for me still gave me a good amount of points but some changed. Good luck!
